method: Fetch root and experiments trees nonrecursively, then both complete input study subtrees recursively; require truncated=false. For every archived file, verify current bytes against archive SHA256/size and compute Git blob SHA1 to compare with an existing remote path. Check file/directory/symlink conflicts as well. R13 is absent in the fixed baseline experiments tree.
scope: Input archive versus the exact inherited baseline tree; no experiment rerun and no frozen-file change. Subsequent unrelated modifications to a user checkout are still refused by the restore command.
